lina (People Ops): Morning @michael  quick one about adding your adult brother as an enrolled dependent due to permanent disability. Carriers need a few specific docs. What do you have on hand?
michael tran: Hey! I have his SSDI award letter, a physician note stating inability to self-support, and a joint lease showing same address. Is that sufficient?
lina (People Ops): That should cover the usual carrier requirements: SSDI award + physician statement + proof of shared residence. If he has a POA that helps too. Make sure all docs are uploaded within 30 days of your QLE event to be eligible for retro coverage.
michael tran: Got it. One snag: the SSDI PDF my brother sent has the SSN partially redacted by his attorney. Will that block things?
samir khan: Heads up from payroll: for retro premium adjustments we need verification within the 30-day window. If docs arrive late, deductions may start next payroll period and retro reimbursements are tougher to process. Also check if claiming him as a tax dependent changes withholding.
lina (People Ops): About the SSN: carriers generally need the full SSN. You have options: 1) Upload the unredacted document via the secure upload path in the portal OR 2) submit the redacted file plus send the SSN through the secure form or email benefits@redwood-inference.com (encrypted). Mark the upload as "contains sensitive info".
benefits-bot: @michael tran Upload steps: 1) Go to hr.redwood-inference.com -> Benefits -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent. 2) Select "Adult Dependent - Disability". 3) Upload: SSDI_award.pdf, physician_statement.pdf, proof_shared_residence.pdf, POA_if_available.pdf. 4) Toggle "Contains sensitive info" if providing SSN. Accepted file types: PDF, JPG, PNG. Max 10MB. Recommended filename format: lastname_firstname_type.pdf
michael tran: Thanks  I uploaded ssdi_award_redacted.pdf and physician_note_202602.pdf, plus lease_scan.jpg. I used the secure form to submit the SSN.
hr-portal-bot: Documents received. Case #DEP-2026-991 opened. Verification ETA 2-3 business days. If carrier requires a full SSN on a specific form we will request next steps.
lina (People Ops): Thanks @michael. Once verification completes we'll confirm effective date and any payroll retro. If you need documentation for a tax advisor or want us to hold a quick call with benefits/payroll, ping me and I'll set it up. :slightly_smiling_face:
